name: tpl-chain-response-1-goal
task: Carry the box to the exit. Whenever the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The task requires the box to be in the agent's hands when the exit is reached, but the compiled clauses only enforce that holding_box must occur before at_exit (Precedence). This does not guarantee the box is still held at the exit. Add a hard clause linking the exit to holding the box, e.g., a hard Response(at_exit, holding_box) (or an equivalent rule ensuring holding_box at the moment of at_exit). Without this, the machine allows finishing without the box, violating the task.

CHANGES REQUIRED: Clause R2 Existence(holding_box) is redundant. The task already requires the box to be held at the exit (via Response(at_exit, holding_box) and the goal Existence(at_exit)), which forces holding_box. A hard Existence on holding_box adds an unnecessary extra requirement. Remove the hard Existence(holding_box) clause.

texts: The agent must eventually reach the exit.
When the agent reaches the exit, it must be holding the box at that moment.
Whenever the box falls, the agent must be holding the box again on the very next step.
